name: side-omnigraph-viz
description: Draws your Claude Code session as a live graph of Claude, its agents, tools and files; hands over to an omnigraph store when you use one. Fork of pronskiy/omnigraph-claude-mod (MIT).

omnigraphBin.title: omnigraph binary
omnigraphBin.description: Name or absolute path of the omnigraph CLI

maxGhostNodes.title: Max ghost nodes
maxGhostNodes.description: Largest graph loaded whole; a bigger one keeps its best-connected nodes

ledgerDir.title: Ledger directory
ledgerDir.description: Where session ledgers are written, relative to the session directory

enrich.title: Enrich
enrich.description: Run omnigraph --json calls in the background for graph detail

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Log viz errors as dim transcript lines
